title: Additivity in the first argument
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability distribution on $\Omega$, and let $f,g,h:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. The expectation of $(f+g)h$ under $\pi$ equals the sum of the expectations of $fh$ and $gh$ under $\pi$.
